Visualize as rotating axes to capture max spread. Practice on small datasets first.","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs can personalize tutoring: generate custom problems based on weak spots, explain steps in simple Italian/English, simulate exams.
